name: External Service Level 1 Code
definition: Specifies the external service level code in the format of character string with a maximum length of 4 characters.|The list of valid codes is an external code list published separately.|External code sets can be downloaded from www.iso20022.org.

NPCA.name: Nordic Payments Council Area Transfer
NPCA.definition: Payments must be executed following the NPC Area Payment scheme.

NUGP.name: Nonurgent Priority Payment
NUGP.definition: Payment must be executed as a non-urgent transaction with priority settlement.

NURG.name: Nonurgent Payment
NURG.definition: Payment must be executed as a non-urgent transaction, which is typically identified as an ACH or low value transaction.

PRPT.name: EBA Priority Service
PRPT.definition: Transaction must be processed according to the EBA Priority Service.

SDVA.name: Same Day Value
SDVA.definition: Payment must be executed with same day value to the creditor.

SEPA.name: Single Euro Payments Area
SEPA.definition: Payment must be executed following the Single Euro Payments Area scheme.

SVDE.name: Domestic Cheque Clearing And Settlement
SVDE.definition: Payment execution following the cheque agreement and traveller cheque agreement of the German Banking Industry Committee (Die Deutsche Kreditwirtschaft - DK) and Deutsche Bundesbank – Scheck Verrechnung Deutschland

URGP.name: Urgent Payment
URGP.definition: Payment must be executed as an urgent transaction cleared through a real-time gross settlement system, which is typically identified as a wire or high value transaction.

URNS.name: Urgent Payment Net Settlement
URNS.definition: Payment must be executed as an urgent transaction cleared through a real-time net settlement system, which is typically identified as a wire or high value transaction.

INST.name: Instant Credit Transfer Or Instant Direct Debit
INST.definition: Used for payment initiation to identify that a Payment or Direct Debit initiation must be executed as an instant or real-time payment instrument.

SRTP.name: Service Request To Pay
SRTP.definition: Request to Pay (RTP) transaction refers to an RTP scheme (such as for example the SEPA Request to Pay (SRTP) scheme).

G006.name: Tracked Case Management
G006.definition: Specifies the service conditions applicable to a tracked exceptions and investigations case.

G007.name: Tracked Inbound Customer Credit Transfer
G007.definition: Specifies the service level for a tracked inbound customer credit transfer.

G009.name: Tracked Low Value Cross Border Customer Credit Transfer
G009.definition: Specifies the service level for a tracked low-value cross-border customer credit transfer.

WFSM.name: Wait For Settlement
WFSM.definition: Transaction is to be treated as an advice and only applied to the account of the creditor or next agent after settlement of the cover has been confirmed.

EOLO.name: Euro One Leg Out
EOLO.definition: Payment is executed following a Euro One-Leg Out Scheme.

SPLI.name: Split Payment
SPLI.definition: A split payment is a payment that is split into several payments of lower value, namely with the purpose to comply with maximum amount thresholds applicable to some domestic Payment Market Infrastructures or to reduce counterparty liquidity risk.

IRCA.name: Icelandic Rulebook Council Area
IRCA.definition: Payment must be executed following the Icelandic Rulebook Council Area (IRCA) scheme.

EAPS.name: East African Payment System
EAPS.definition: Identifies payments executed under the East African Payment System (EAPS), the regional cross-border settlement scheme operated by EAC central banks.

SPSC.name: Swift Scheme
SPSC.definition: Transaction must be processed according to the Swift Scheme rulebook.

SD01.name: Swift Digital Service Swift Ledger
SD01.definition: Digital asset transactions must be processed according to the Swift Ledger rules.

NOLO.name: NPC One Leg Out
NOLO.definition: Payment is executed following the NPC One-Leg Out Scheme.
